title: Uhura: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Question Answering and Truthfulness in Low-Resource African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot and few-shot accuracy of various large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice science and truthfulness benchmarks (ARC-Easy and TruthfulQA) between English and six low-resource African languages (Amharic, Hausa, Northern Sotho, Swahili, Yoruba, and Zulu).

Qualitative analysis by native translators and language coordinators to identify Western-centric historical references, region-specific cultural contexts, and negative stereotypes about Africa within the original English benchmark datasets during the translation process.
